trajectories.name: confident-surprised-stubborn
trajectories.label: Strong prior violated; refuses to update

trajectories.name: uncertain-bored-confirmed
trajectories.label: Weak prior reinforced by expected outcome

prior.curious: Open expectation. The character has no specific prediction; they are in an exploratory mindset, willing to be moved by whatever the evidence shows.
prior.uncertain: The character holds a tentative belief but acknowledges low confidence in it. They hedge their expectation. They have a leaning, but it could be wrong.
prior.confident: The character holds a strong specific prediction and expects a particular outcome. They are committed to this expectation.

discovery.surprised: The outcome is unexpected and engaging. The evidence does NOT match the prior expectation. Something stands out and demands attention.
discovery.bored: The outcome is plain and unremarkable. The evidence MATCHES the prior expectation closely. Nothing stands out.

reaction.stubborn: The character refuses to update their belief despite the contradiction. They explain it away, dismiss it, or reaffirm the prior position.
reaction.enlightened: The character genuinely updates their understanding. Previous pieces fall into place; the framework restructures.
reaction.confused: The character cannot resolve the contradiction. They remain in unresolved tension; no settled interpretation forms.
reaction.confirmed: The expected match consolidates the previously tentative belief into a settled one. Confidence increases on what was already leaned toward.
